entry.question: Formalize nonnegative harmonic modal energies on a nonempty finite monitored mode set, late-window averages for 0 <= mu < 1 and T>0, normalized modal weights, and approximate equipartition as L1 distance to the uniform probability vector. Prove normalization and elementary distance bounds. Use Mathlib finite sums and interval integrals; consult Physlib statistical mechanics and thermodynamics definitions without replacing the observable by an equilibrium axiom.
